speak: Every year, the African diaspora sends hundreds of billions of dollars home. A transfer moves the money, but it does not control what the money is used for.
caption: Every year, the African diaspora sends hundreds of billions of dollars home. A transfer moves the money, but it does not control what the money is used for.

speak: Nob Pay fixes that. The money stays in escrow, and it is released step by step, only when the work is shown.
caption: NobPay fixes that. The money stays in escrow, and it is released step by step, only when the work is shown.

speak: And anyone can verify the record, without trusting us.
caption: And anyone can verify the record, without trusting us.

speak: This is the live demo. Payments are simulated, so nothing here moves real money. We sign in with the demo account.
caption: This is the live demo. Payments are simulated, so nothing here moves real money. We sign in with the demo account.

speak: A funder follows a residence being built back home. One proof is waiting for her decision, and nothing is paid without her approval.
caption: A funder follows a residence being built back home. One proof is waiting for her decision, and nothing is paid without her approval.

speak: Money enters escrow through a Lightning invoice. Here she adds five hundred dollars.
caption: Money enters escrow through a Lightning invoice. Here she adds five hundred dollars.

speak: The invoice comes with a QR code. In this demo it cannot be paid, so we simulate the payment, and the escrow is credited.
caption: The invoice comes with a QR code. In this demo it cannot be paid, so we simulate the payment, and the escrow is credited.

speak: Now the residence project. Each step is paid only against proof.
caption: Now the residence project. Each step is paid only against proof.

speak: This step has a proof waiting: geotagged photos, the supplier's invoice, and who should be paid. The funder looks, then decides.
caption: This step has a proof waiting: geotagged photos, the supplier's invoice, and who should be paid. The funder looks, then decides.

speak: Before paying, she sees the quote: what is debited, the rate, the fees, and what the supplier receives.
caption: Before paying, she sees the quote: what is debited, the rate, the fees, and what the supplier receives.

speak: She confirms, and the supplier is paid directly, by mobile money. The confirmation comes back as a signed event.
caption: She confirms, and the supplier is paid directly, by mobile money. The confirmation comes back as a signed event.

speak: Then the next step opens, and the person on site is asked for the next proof.
caption: Then the next step opens, and the person on site is asked for the next proof.

speak: They need no account, just a private link. The photo is dated and located by the phone, and they add the supplier's invoice.
caption: They need no account, just a private link. The photo is dated and located by the phone, and they add the supplier's invoice.

speak: They say who should be paid, and by which mobile money, then send the proof. The funder is notified, and decides.
caption: They say who should be paid, and by which mobile money, then send the proof. The funder is notified, and decides.

speak: Every event joins a hash chained ledger. Change one line, and everything after it breaks.
caption: Every event joins a hash-chained ledger. Change one line, and everything after it breaks.

speak: We anchor its fingerprint on Bitcoin, with Open Timestamps. Only the fingerprint leaves the app.
caption: We anchor its fingerprint on Bitcoin, with OpenTimestamps. Only the fingerprint leaves the app.

speak: A public page lets anyone check the file, without an account. The browser redoes the calculations itself.
caption: A public page lets anyone check the file, without an account. The browser redoes the calculations itself.

speak: So nobody has to trust our server.
caption: So nobody has to trust our server.

speak: What is real: the ledger, the Bitcoin anchoring, and the verification. The Lightning path is tested against a wallet simulator, not yet with real sats, and Nostr publishing is off on this free demo.
caption: What is real: the ledger, the Bitcoin anchoring, and the verification. The Lightning path is tested against a wallet simulator, not yet with real sats, and Nostr publishing is off on this free demo.

speak: Nob Pay: pay on proof. Try it at nob pay dot on render dot com. The code is open source on GitHub.
caption: NobPay: pay on proof. Try it at nobpay.onrender.com. The code is open source on GitHub.
